text:
Type: tall rice paper floor lamp
Use: soft ambient light in a corner or beside a sofa or bed; living room, bedroom
Style: Japandi, Scandinavian, minimalist
Materials: white rice paper shade with ribbed wire frame, dark metal base and short stem, foot switch on the cord
Colors: off-white, warm glow, dark grey base
Shape: tall slim column shade with horizontal ribs, standing on a short stem and small round base, lantern-like, tall but light
Feel: calm, soft, warm, serene
Goes with: light wood, linen, bamboo, green plants, white walls; Japandi, Scandinavian or minimalist rooms
